name: tpl-precedence-1-goal~p3
task: First move the ball off the door, then take the key, open the door with it and pick up the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a hard ordered sequence (move the ball, take the key, open the door, pick up the box). The clauses encode it as a complete Precedence chain: blocker_moved before has_door_key, has_door_key before door_open, and door_open before target_picked_up. The hard Existence on target_picked_up forces the whole chain, so no redundant Existence clauses are needed, and every clause is hard as the task requires.

texts: Eventually pick up the target box (the final step of the ordered sequence)
Open the door only after the key has been taken, so the key is in hand before the door is opened
Open the door with the key only after the key has been taken
Take the key only after the ball has been moved off the door
